description: This Dart source file defines a UserProvider class for managing user authentication and profile data in a Flutter app. It interacts with shared preferences for token storage and calls an API service for profile data, including login and logout functionality.

classes.name: UserProfile
classes.description: Represents the user's profile data including id, name, email, loyalty points, and avatar URL.

classes.name: UserProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class that manages user authentication state, profile data, and provides login and logout methods.

methods.name: _loadProfile
methods.description: Loads the user's profile data from the API asynchronously.

methods.name: loginWithSocial
methods.description: Performs social login with a given provider, stores the token, and loads the user profile.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears user authentication data and profile from local storage and state.
